diagnosis: The DownloadCompensationReview Echo handler retrieves compensation review PDF documents using only the reviewID parameter. Although JWT authentication ensures the user is an employee, the handler does not verify that the review document belongs to the requesting employee or that the requester is an authorized HR manager. Any employee can download colleagues' salary reviews.
exploit_request:
GET /hr/compensation/reviews/comp_rev_9901 HTTP/1.1
Host: hr-portal.workplace.com
Authorization: Bearer regular_employee_jwt
Accept: application/pdf
